description.text: Students can apply for the program all year round. Compulsory courses: Intermediate Chinese: Students taking these courses also use Duiwai Hanyu Xilie Jiaocai (second-year text), but these texts are often supplemented with additional materilas like International Chinese Listening and Speaking to broaden the scope of their knowledge and to improve their communication skills. Optional Couses: 1. Calligraphy: Introduing the original and aesthetic meaning of Chinese characters and appreciating the deep conotation of Chinese calligraphy. 2. History and Culture: Introduing the mysterious culture and long history of China. 3. Maritial Arts: A window for foreign students learning about China, at the same time improves physical strength. 4. Chinese Folk Songs: Learning to sing traditional Chinese folk songs. 5. Guidance Class for Chinese Level Exams (HSK): On the request of students, thus special guidance class is offered for further studies or specific occupations.

duration.text: The Intermediate Chinese Language Learning Program at Southwest Jiaotong University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2152 USD/per year ￥ 15500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: High school graduate, in good health
